summary: Order placement has been failing since about 13:10 UTC because of order-router deploy order-router-00418 ("refactor order validation"), made at 13:09. Starting at 13:10:07, order-router logs repeated unhandled `KeyError 'limit_price'` exceptions in place_order, and its err_rate reached 0.305 (last 0.304). The downstream broker-gateway is healthy (err_rate max 0.007, rate limit headroom intact), so this is not a dependency failure. The other deploys in the window (auth-kyc, msg-delivery, llm-gateway) were earlier and are low-risk by their notes. The timing and the exception strongly suggest the refactor broke handling of orders without a limit_price, but I did not inspect the code diff or the request mix.

hypotheses.statement: Deploy order-router-00418 (order validation refactor) introduced a bug that raises KeyError 'limit_price' in place_order, causing the order failures.
hypotheses.label: medium

supporting.text: order-router deploy 'refactor order validation' landed one minute before the first error
First order-router error is a KeyError on limit_price in place_order, 13:10:07
order-router error rate rose to about 30%, and 150 matching errors were found (log result truncated)
The refactored validation likely assumes limit_price is always present, so orders without it (e.g. market orders) raise KeyError. The code diff and the share of affected orders were not checked.

hypotheses.statement: A downstream dependency (broker-gateway) is failing and causing the order errors.
hypotheses.label: low

contradicting.text: broker-gateway, the main callee of order-router, shows no elevated errors

unresolved: The code diff of order-router-00418 was not inspected, so the exact missing-field path is unconfirmed.
The error logs were truncated (150 matches, 30 shown); the full error timeline and any other error types were not reviewed.
The share of orders affected is unknown (err_rate about 30%), as is whether only certain order types (e.g. market orders) fail.
Whether any orders were partially submitted to the broker before failing was not checked.

actions.text: Roll back order-router to the version before order-router-00418, or hotfix place_order to handle a missing limit_price (e.g. payload.get('limit_price')).
actions.rationale: The error started right after this deploy and is a code-level KeyError in place_order, so a rollback should stop order failures quickly.

actions.text: After rollback, confirm order-router err_rate returns to about 0.003 and that the KeyError no longer appears in logs.
actions.rationale: Verifies recovery and confirms the deploy was the cause.

actions.text: Review the order-router-00418 diff and add a regression test for orders with no limit_price. Tell support so affected customers can retry orders.
actions.rationale: Prevents recurrence and handles the 40+ tickets from failed orders.
